reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text:
Worst streaming app experience. Period.

This app never works as expected. Not once. Forget TV support. Apple TV is a joke. Even on mobile, where it should at least be stable, it constantly fails.

You open the app, it hangs.
You close it. Open again.
Repeat this multiple times just to watch one thing.

Sometimes it doesn’t even show the Play button. That’s not a bug, that’s absurd. A streaming app where you can’t play content. Very funny, honestly. I’m not sure how the app expects users to watch anything at all.

The usual response is always the same: reinstall, update, contact support, wait for fixes. I’ve done all of that. Multiple times. Nothing changes. The problems are clearly deeper than “use the latest version.”

If basic functionality like opening the app, recognizing subscriptions, and showing a play button doesn’t work reliably, updates and scripted support replies don’t help. The core experience is broken.

This is easily one of the worst app experiences I’ve had. Until the fundamentals are fixed, this app is simply not usable.
